## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Simulate and identify
```{r arma-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=18}
library(fpp3)
set.seed(1)
ar1 <- tibble(
  idx = seq_len(300),
  y = as.numeric(arima.sim(model = list(ar = 0.7), n = 300))
) |> as_tsibble(index = idx)
ma1 <- tibble(
  idx = seq_len(300),
  y = as.numeric(arima.sim(model = list(ma = 0.7), n = 300))
) |> as_tsibble(index = idx)
ar1 |> ACF(y) |> autoplot()
ar1 |> PACF(y) |> autoplot()
ma1 |> ACF(y) |> autoplot()
ma1 |> PACF(y) |> autoplot()
fit <- ar1 |> model(ARIMA(y ~ pdq(1, 0, 0) + PDQ(0, 0, 0)))
report(fit)
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Cuts off after lag 1", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Is zero at every lag"),
  answer("Has a spike only at lag 12"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Cuts off after lag 1", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Never dies"),
  answer("Equals the PACF exactly always"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "AR(1): … MA(1): …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```
